newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF June barometer rises 0.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF June barometer rises 0.2 pct.

text.p: Switzerland's Institute for Business Cycle Research (KOF) said its economic barometer rose a provisional 0.2 percent in June for a year-on-year rise of 1.6 percent.

"In light of the continuous rise in the KOF/ETH economic barometer since October 1996, the prospects are intact for a slight pickup in the economy from the second half of 1997 and in the first months of the coming year," said KOF, part of the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology (ETH).
In May the barometer had risen 0.1 percent from April for a year-on-year rise of 1.3 percent.
KOF said all its five leading indicators had risen slightly in June from the previous month.
It also said the Manpower Index of vacant jobs had continued to rise, just as the employment prospects in industry had improved in the second quarter.
Work on hand in the machinery sector also rose and the decline in leading construction indicators eased.
Real money supply also rose, albeit not as strongly as in the previous month, KOF said.
